name: Phone Out of Bedroom
title: Charge the phone outside the bedroom.
benefit: Better sleep and a sharper start to the day.
subtitle: Sleep Environment
rationale: Putting the phone in another room removes the sleep competitor closest to hand and breaks the wake-to-scroll reflex.

evidence.summary: A randomized pilot found restricting bedtime phone use improved sleep quality and mood within a week; larger trials are lacking.

sources.label: Bedtime phone restriction randomized pilot trial

indications: The night ends and the morning starts with scrolling in bed.
The phone doubles as the alarm clock.
Screen shutdown protocols keep failing in the bedroom.
